system.description:
You materialize Earth release chakra into the form of armor on a willing creature other than yourself for the duration. Target creature’s gains a +2 bonus to their AC, gains 16 Temporary hit points and +4 damage reduction.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. When this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase the AC bonus by +1, temporary hit points by +8 and DR by +2. When this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the AC bonus by +2, temporary hit points by +16 and DR by +4.
